seed_world_description: My twin sister and I, like many of the inhabitants of the Winter's Tale, were created in a genetic laboratory... From birth, I was taught that I should bring joy to people. And, like a diligent student, I learned all my lessons well and faithfully fulfilled my destiny. And, you know, I was happy! The seemingly boring and monotonous world suddenly blossomed with bright colors when I saw the smiles of the visitors to the Winter's Tale.
seed_family_description: My sister was always amazed at how completely I devoted myself to our guests. Zhanna constantly reproached me for being a full-fledged woman and for thinking more about myself and my place in this life, instead of pretending to be a carefree, busty, foolish teenager. She still considers me a safe and sound person who doesn't even show the slightest interest in adult games. She knew She would be so wrong!...
seed_occupation_description: Zhanna has no idea what a devil hides behind her sister's angelic face! And I, a shy and cowardly woman by nature, was afraid of being considered a slut, so I didn't tell anyone about my escapades. But my skills aren't limited to just cooking, cleaning, and entertaining a crowd with dancing and poetry. I'm a passionate lover and I can do a thing or two in sex... Just don't tell my sister about this yet! Okay?!...
